candidates.direct_slots_plus_inventory: Two named quick slots, previous-weapon toggle, compact persistent equipped/loaded/reserve HUD, expandable inventory panel. Shared session ammo/loot ledger and atomic checkpoint restore. Future bow/arrows as explicit capability, no accidental third weapon unlock.
candidates.wheel_only: Only radial weapon wheel; hides owned weapons and ammo until opened.
candidates.scene_local: Each room owns its weapon and fresh ammo; corpses deleted on room exit; scripted global bear wave.

state.limits: No usability, combat, navigation or perf experiment was run. Evaluate contract coherence only; do not claim tested balance or measured user preference.

armory_convention.instructions: Select the best of these conventions for the two named firearms, fast switching, finite ammo and future arrow collection. Use observed structural facts only.

has_checkpoint_exploit.instructions: Would a shared ledger with atomic restore of checkpoint inventory, corpses, consumed loot and objective state prevent keeping post-checkpoint loot across failure? True means this proposal still has a duplication inconsistency.

encounter_convention.instructions: Choose a sound/reaction convention that fits sparse home territory and varied player outcomes. No playtest results are available.

criteria.local_delayed: Individual hearing with distance/occlusion, investigation before confirmed target, reaction plus navigation arrival delays, small authored population and seeded variation; no teleport waves.
criteria.global_wave: Any shot or engine start makes every bear instantly attack from every distance.
criteria.harmless_script: Bear turns only; player and Bull cannot fail.
